name: LocalizationReadmeWindow
src_typeComment: Toolkit > Localization > How To Use.  Exists because the rest of this folder answers "what can it do" and nobody was answering "what do I actually click". The three steps below ARE the whole system; everything else in the folder is an optional extra you reach for once you hit the problem it solves.  Every step has a button that performs it, so this is a place to DO the setup from rather than a page to read and then go and find the menus yourself.
